name: TVIR
abstract: TVIR evaluates text-visual interleaved deep-research report generation with joint textual and visual assessment. This page uses the Overall Avg from Table 1.
method: TVIR targets deep-research agents that generate text-visual interleaved reports instead of text-only outputs.
The paper introduces TVIR-BENCH and TVIR-AGENT, and jointly evaluates citation support, writing quality, figure quality, and text-visual integration.
The results show that TVIR-Agent variants with explicit multimodal planning and writing pipelines outperform existing deep-research systems overall.

metrics.name: Overall Avg
metrics.note: Mean of textual assessment and visual assessment in Table 1.

leaderboard_note: The leaderboard uses the Overall Avg from Table 1 and keeps only systems with complete visual evaluation; the text-only Gemini-3-Pro Deep Research row is excluded.
